channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Agri & fertilisers in Indian markets. Today: headwind (−1.6).

item.title: [−3] IMD predicts below-normal rainfall across southern peninsula in November
item.description:
Signal: weak monsoon or sowing. 7 reports from DD News, CMB News, Bhaskar English and 4 more. Related: “November Rainfall: IMD Forecasts Below-normal Southern Total”. New in the last 24 hours.

Agri & fertilisers: strong headwind (−3) — Crop output at risk

Why it matters: Poor rains hurt harvests and rural incomes, weighing on rural demand and raising food inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Growth outlook −1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Gor hopes to take US-India trade deal 'across the finish line'; hints at 'exciting outcomes' ahead of G20
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 14 reports from News On AIR, Moneycontrol.com, The Times of India and 10 more. Related: “U.S.-India near trade deal, Sergio Gor says at G-20”. Ongoing: also reported on 3 of the previous 7 days (first 25 Oct).

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Farm exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Global food price surge adds to India’s inflation challenge
item.description:
Signal: rising Indian food prices (India). 1 report from AgroSpectrum India. New in the last 24 hours.

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Better farm-gate prices

Why it matters: Food carries a large weight in India's CPI, so rising food prices squeeze household budgets and limit the RBI's room to cut rates.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −3, Bond market (G-Secs) −1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
